<!DOCTYPE html>

<style>
:root{--bg:#080808;--fg:#f4f4f4;--muted:#777;--line:#252525}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;overflow-x:hidden}
body:before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.11;background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 180 180' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.9' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='.28'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");z-index:5}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.wrap{width:min(1180px,90%);margin:auto}
nav{height:88px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.logo{font-size:25px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-2px}
.navlinks{display:flex;gap:34px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#999;text-transform:uppercase}
.navlinks a:hover,.social a:hover{color:#fff}
.hero{min-height:690px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 390px;align-items:center;gap:7%;padding:80px 0}
.eyebrow{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:4px;color:#888;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:24px}
h1{font-size:clamp(68px,12vw,150px);line-height:.82;letter-spacing:-.085em;margin:0;font-weight:800}
.role{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:3px;color:#777;text-transform:uppercase;margin:28px 0 0 8px}
.hero-note{max-width:370px;color:#888;line-height:1.8;font-size:13px;margin-top:55px}
.portrait{height:490px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#171717;filter:grayscale(100%)}
.portrait img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 35%;opacity:.88;transition:transform .8s}
.portrait:hover img{transform:scale(1.035)}
.portrait:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border:1px solid #ffffff22;pointer-events:none}
.side-label{position:absolute;right:-32px;bottom:0;writing-mode:vertical-rl;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:3px;color:#777}
.section{padding:110px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.section-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;margin-bottom:48px}
.kicker{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:3px;color:#777;text-transform:uppercase}
h2{font-size:clamp(36px,6vw,72px);letter-spacing:-.06em;margin:12px 0 0}
.projects{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}
.project{height:300px;background:#141414;position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:end;padding:22px}
.project:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(0deg,#000c,transparent 70%)}
.project img{position:absolute;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;filter:grayscale(1);opacity:.55;transition:.6s}
.project:hover img{transform:scale(1.06);opacity:.8}
.project span{z-index:1;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase}
.project:nth-child(1){background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%,#555,#111 65%)}
.project:nth-child(2){background:linear-gradient(135deg,#292929,#090909)}
.project:nth-child(3){background:linear-gradient(35deg,#444,#111 60%)}
.contact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9%}
.contact-copy{color:#888;line-height:1.8;max-width:390px;font-size:13px}
.social{display:flex;flex-direction:column;margin-top:40px}
.social a{padding:19px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:1px}
.social small{color:#666;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px}
footer{padding:30px 0 45px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;color:#666;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);transition:opacity .8s,transform .8s}
.reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:none}
@media(max-width:800px){
 nav{height:72px}.navlinks{gap:14px;font-size:8px}
 .hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:45px;padding:75px 0 95px;min-height:auto}
 .portrait{height:min(115vw,520px);width:100%;max-width:440px;justify-self:center}
 .hero-note{margin-top:35px}
 .projects{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:14px}.project{height:260px}
 .section{padding:75px 0}.contact-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:40px}
 .side-label{display:none}
}
@media(max-width:420px){.navlinks{gap:10px}.navlinks a{font-size:7px;letter-spacing:1px}.logo{font-size:21px}}
</style>
</head>

<script>
const observer=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('visible');observer.unobserve(e.target)}}),{threshold:.12});
document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el=>observer.observe(el));
document.getElementById('discord').addEventListener('click',async e=>{
 e.preventDefault();const label=document.getElementById('copy-label');
 try{await navigator.clipboard.writeText('hvhlegitt');label.textContent='COPIED!'}
 catch{label.textContent='hvhlegitt'}
});
</script>
